title: Guriya bar Chama
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Berakhot 53b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.53b.11), Rava recited the blessing at the end of Shabbat over [the light of] Guriya [bar] Chama’s household. Perhaps he was the son of Rav Chama bar Guriya.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Bavli has Guriya bar Chama. Hyman’s sentence omits bar, though his heading supplies it.

[Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=842&lang=en) says that Guriya was the son of Chama bar Guriya and was named for his grandfather. Hyman presents the father’s identification as a possibility.
